summary: Squat-heavy block. Squat climbs a gated ladder 315→365→385→405; sumo is the moderate lift at a fixed 225/275. Bench, pull-up and dip keep strive waves with staggered peaks (dip W3, bench + pull-up W4).

exercises.name: Low-bar Squat
exercises.notes: W1 CALIBRATION — fixed, no rung claimed. You are still on baclofen today (course ends ~Sep 30): baclofen lowers muscle tone, and tone is the brace. Nothing heavier than written. SQUAT FIRST on D1 — never squat heavy pre-fatigued. Backoffs 4x4 @ 275: crisp, every set started fresh. If the rung holds, the backoffs hold with it.
exercises.hold_reason: Squat is on axial-return-ladder: every rung is an absolute load gated on the prior squat day's next-morning back check. Written below the log on purpose; the sync must not rebase it.

exercises.name: Comp Bench
exercises.notes: W1 calibration. Top @7. PRIORITY LIFT — strive. ≤3/10 shoulder pain, always. Arch moderates before load does if the back complains.

exercises.name: Tricep Pushdown
exercises.notes: Triceps / lockout carryover. D1 accessories stay off Tuesday's pull.

exercises.name: Chest Fly (Machine)
exercises.notes: NEW (expansion): chest isolation — the program only hits chest through presses, and you asked for chest work. A FLY, not a press, so no extra pressing exposure. SHOULDER RULE: stop the handles before your elbows travel behind your torso — the stretched bottom loads the anterior capsule where the subscapularis tear is. Last logged 115×11 (Dec 2025, nine months ago) — re-entry below it.
exercises.hold_reason: First exposure / long-gap re-entry — deliberately under any log anchor until two sessions set a real one.
